main_text.p: ne termini uel eiusdem loci, ut in dire-cta proportione: uel diuersorum, ut in reciproca.
main_text.head: Prioris exempla sunto.

p.i: 1. Studiosi quatuor, trimestri 19 aureos impendunt: quantū igitur studiosi octo, mensibus nouem, impendent?

main_text.p: Vides hîc principes terminos temporis circumstantia quaesitos[?], atque ideò (seruatis Regulæ aureæ dispositionis legibus) primum atq; tertium duplices esse, sic:
Quare pro binis singulos, multiplicatione composita, assumo. Vt pro 4 & 3 sumo 12, pro 8 & 9 usurpo 72, nempe factos ab ipsis. Vnde composita proportio sic concludetur.

Hîc inter quatuor studiosorum impensas spatio tri
mestri, eadem seruatur proportio, quæ inter impensas 8 stud. 9 mensibus, composita nempe ex duabus 4 ad 8, 3 ad 9, seu ut planiùs loquar: ita adinuicem sese impense habent, sicut ter quatuor ad nouies octo. Idmanife
ste

page.notes: Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are cut off; not transcribed. The word after "circumstantia" is doubtful. The table in the first line of the table is partly read from its alignment. Left margin strip, cut by the scan edge, reads: "ibus dus", "cipalis", "portios", "ab illis", "cationc" (partial, not fully legible). Line ends of the main text are partly rendered as printed; the final word "Idmanifeste" is broken across lines and the last syllable appears as "ste" on its own line. Some marks in the text ("8", "3") are reference signs or fractions as printed. The text is set in italic in the printed page; the running head "Vel" is followed by a numeral "1" and page number "6".
